features.quote: A small opening leads into a burial chamber (4 x 5 m)
features.subtype: rock-cut burial cave with kokhim (loculi), rock-cut facade

date.basis: finds in the tomb (lamps and vessels) dated by the report to the Roman period, 1st-2nd c. CE; 'Roman' counts as D (PROTOCOL 6)

notes: The whole report concerns one excavated burial cave (kokhim tomb with golel stones). The report gives no location of the cave within Kh. Ibziq (no direction or distance) and has no plan, so position is none. No water installation is described; silence is not coded as absence. Dated D from the report's Roman (1st-2nd c. CE) finds.
